text: TCS reported weaker-than-expected quarterly revenue as clients delayed IT spending amid a slowing global economy.
RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps citing persistent inflation concerns, third hike this year.
Reliance Industries announces new energy joint venture with Saudi Aramco, expanding green hydrogen capacity.
Nifty IT index falls 3% as US clients signal broader tech budget freezes for FY27.
Government approves new PLI scheme for semiconductor manufacturing, boosting related stocks.
Rising tensions in the Red Sea shipping routes raise concerns over crude oil supply chains.
HDFC Bank posts steady quarterly earnings in line with analyst expectations, no major surprises.
Infosys reiterates FY27 guidance, reaffirming prior growth targets with no major changes.
Adani Ports wins new container terminal contract, expected to boost cargo volumes significantly.
Global chip shortage eases as major foundries report improved supply, benefiting Indian IT hardware importers.
SEBI tightens disclosure norms for related-party transactions, raising compliance costs for listed firms.
US Federal Reserve signals potential rate cuts later this year, boosting risk appetite in emerging markets.
Maruti Suzuki reports flat sales for the month, broadly matching seasonal expectations.
Escalating trade tensions between US and China raise concerns over global auto component supply chains.
Union Budget increases capital expenditure allocation for infrastructure, benefiting construction and cement stocks.
